title: You Are On God’s Heart At All Times
verse: He put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of memorial for the Israelites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
observation: In this chapter, we see that the stones placed over the chest of the high priest were to be a reminder of his purpose. He was there as a representative of the people of God before God. The stones along with the weight over his shoulders would remind the high priest of his role and keep the people of God on his mind. The high priest was a forerunner of what Jesus would eventually become. The book of Hebrews says Jesus is our true High Priest. Therefore, the stones remind us that Jesus was our representative and took our place before the judgment seat of God. This is a beautiful picture because He was also the Judge. He knew the penalty and realized what our sin would cost. He took on our sin and made a way for us to enter into the Holy of holies through His sacrifice. Jesus is our true High Priest. This text reminds us of what Jesus did for us because He loves us. We are always on His mind.
application: You are never alone. You are never forgotten. God is always mindful of you.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.
